values.note: Plowed in winter (access to the Ward Hills Snowmobile Trail).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/timber-creek-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Year-round; plowed in winter'; 'In the winter this site is plowed and provides access to the Ward Hills Snowmobile Trail.'), read 2026-10-25

note: Manistee NF rustic campground in Lake County near a small impoundment (not a popular fishing spot, per the Forest Service); its busiest use is the North Country Trail trailhead in the campground. ORV use is prohibited in the campground. --Claude
